title: CerebralHelm Calendar Create Event Input
description: Creates one event in the user's calendar. `startsAt`/`endsAt` are LOCAL WALL-CLOCK ISO strings (`2026-08-03T14:00:00`), not UTC instants — the same convention the calendar read side uses (NIC-126), so a time the user typed into a form means the time they meant. The adapter resolves them in the host's time zone.

calendarId.description: Which calendar to write to. Omitted uses the host's default calendar — never a guess at which one the user meant.
